paragraphs: The name of a thief and armed bandit in the time of Rav Nachman; [Bava Metzia 93b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.93b.12).[^2]

notes.text: Bava Metzia93b names Shabbu in a case brought before Rav Nachman. The frozen Hyman abbreviation is ר״ג; its discrepancy remains unresolved rather than being silently changed.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 1108) has ר״נ, whereas the supplied Hebrew has ר״ג. The linked Bavli places the case before Rav Nachman. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Bava_Metzia.93b.12.1) explains that Shabbu was the name of the armed bandit.
